articles.title_en: The pure benefit of risk in production: real options in general equilibrium
articles.title_cn: 生产中风险的纯收益：一般均衡中的实物期权
articles.abstract_en: An increase in the riskiness of a technology will raise economy-wide expected output: large productivity realizations lead to gains while small realizations are mitigated by using alternative technologies. Some usage of even the riskiest technologies can therefore bring Pareto improvements. The observed expected output of risky technologies can nevertheless be less than that of safer technologies: empirical estimates of expected output are therefore a poor measure of efficiency. Firms will adopt the efficient riskier technologies when markets are competitive, contrary to the view that innovation requires a monopoly reward. These results require a suitable definition of risk for general equilibrium models and a refinement of competitive equilibrium that allows for information discovery. The efficiency gain of increases in risk is related to real options theories of investment but applies even to single-period economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 技术风险性的增加将提高整个经济体的预期产出：大的生产率实现带来收益，而小的实现则通过使用替代技术得到缓解。因此，即使是最风险技术的某些使用也能带来帕累托改进。然而，风险技术的观测预期产出可能仍低于更安全的技术：因此，预期产出的经验估计是衡量效率的较差指标。当市场具有竞争性时，企业将采用高效的风险技术，这与创新需要垄断回报的观点相反。这些结果需要对一般均衡模型中的风险进行适当定义，并细化允许信息发现的竞争均衡。风险增加带来的效率收益与投资的实物期权理论相关，但甚至适用于单期经济体。

articles.title_en: Nudging punishment against sharing of fake news
articles.title_cn: 推动对分享假新闻的惩罚
articles.abstract_en: Corrective comments posted in response to misinformation shared on social media are not only effective in reducing belief in misinformation among those observing the interaction but also serve as a publicly observable social punishment against fake news sharing. We suggest that, by visibly displaying punishing behavior, corrective comments have the potential to function as a norm nudge, updating observers’ perception of the norms regulating punishment, the so-called “meta-norms”. We conducted a preregistered online experiment in which participants joined discussions resembling an online forum and could comment on posts shared by previous users. We manipulated participants’ possibility to observe corrective comments replying to a post sharing fake news and measured the effect of this variation on their propensity to leave a corrective comment. We show that participants exposed to posts corrected by other users are significantly more likely to reply with a corrective comment, even after controlling for participants’ perceived accuracy of the shared post. Participants exposed to the corrections provided by previous users perceive replying with corrections as more socially appropriate. Our results suggest that social corrections work as a (meta) norm nudge, increasing the probability of punishing norm violations by increasing the social appropriateness of correcting. Our findings suggest that interventions targeting “would-be” enforcers could complement existing policies specifically directed at norm violators.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对社交媒体上分享的错误信息发布的纠正性评论，不仅有效减少观察互动者中对错误信息的相信，而且作为一种公开可见的社交惩罚，针对假新闻分享。我们建议，通过可见地展示惩罚行为，纠正性评论有潜力作为规范助推，更新观察者对规范惩罚的感知，即所谓的“元规范”。我们进行了一项预注册的在线实验，参与者加入类似在线论坛的讨论，并可以对先前用户分享的帖子发表评论。我们操纵了参与者观察回复分享假新闻帖子的纠正性评论的可能性，并测量了这一变化对他们留下纠正性评论倾向的影响。我们表明，接触过其他用户纠正的帖子的参与者，显著更可能回复纠正性评论，即使在控制参与者对分享帖子的感知准确性后也是如此。接触过先前用户提供的纠正的参与者，认为回复纠正更社交上适当。我们的结果表明，社交纠正作为（元）规范助推，通过增加纠正的社交适当性来提高惩罚规范违规的概率。我们的发现表明，针对“潜在执行者”的干预措施可以补充现有专门针对规范违规者的政策。

articles.title_en: The limited impact of free college policies
articles.title_cn: 免费大学政策的有限影响
articles.abstract_en: Despite the growing popularity of free college proposals, countries with higher subsidies often exhibit higher enrollment rates, but not necessarily higher graduation rates. This paper investigates the mediating role of student effort in the impact of tuition-free policies. We estimate a dynamic model of college enrollment, academic progression, and graduation using comprehensive student-level data from Colombia. In the model, student effort directly influences class completion and moderates the risk of poor performance or dropout. Simulating two policy scenarios — universal free college and performance-based free college — we find that universal free college triggers the largest enrollment increase but minimal change in graduation rates, aligning with observed cross-country patterns. Meanwhile, performance-based free college induces a more moderate enrollment expansion while simultaneously yielding a higher graduation rate. This divergence stems from the differing mechanisms of these policies: universal free college primarily addresses financial constraints, whereas performance-based incentives promote enhanced student effort.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管免费大学提案日益流行，但补贴较高的国家往往入学率更高，但毕业率未必更高。本文研究了学生努力在免学费政策影响中的中介作用。我们利用哥伦比亚全面的学生层面数据，估计了一个包含大学入学、学业进展和毕业的动态模型。在模型中，学生努力直接影响课程完成情况，并调节学业表现不佳或辍学的风险。模拟两种政策情景——全民免费大学和基于表现的免费大学——我们发现，全民免费大学引发最大的入学增长，但毕业率变化极小，这与观察到的跨国模式一致。与此同时，基于表现的免费大学则带来更为温和的入学扩张，同时产生更高的毕业率。这种差异源于这些政策的不同机制：全民免费大学主要解决经济约束，而基于表现的激励则促进增强学生努力。

articles.title_en: Beyond social influence: Examining the efficacy of non-social recommendations
articles.title_cn: 超越社会影响：检验非社会性建议的效力
articles.abstract_en: Do recommendations need to contain social information to change behaviour in allocation and risk tasks? We conducted two online experiments involving 1280 participants to compare the behavioural influence of recommendations based on normatively relevant information with that of recommendations that were transparently random. Although social recommendations generally shifted choices towards the recommended option, consistent with previous studies on norm compliance, their effects were statistically indistinguishable from those of random recommendations. This finding challenges the notion that norm compliance is the sole mechanism through which social recommendations exert their influence. In a follow-up study with 481 participants, we investigated four additional channels. Our results suggest that recommendations do not act as reminders of existing normative knowledge, but we find evidence partially consistent with recommendation following in order to deflect responsibility, because of an anchoring effect, and because of a social norm to follow recommendations.
articles.abstract_cn: 建议是否需要包含社会信息才能改变分配和风险任务中的行为？我们进行了两项涉及1280名参与者的在线实验，以比较基于规范性相关信息和建议与透明随机建议的行为影响。尽管社会性建议通常将选择转向推荐选项，与先前关于规范遵从的研究一致，但其影响在统计上与随机建议无显著差异。这一发现挑战了规范遵从是社会性建议发挥影响的唯一机制的观点。在一项涉及481名参与者的后续研究中，我们调查了另外四种渠道。我们的结果表明，建议并不作为现有规范性知识的提醒，但我们发现了部分与以下机制一致的证据：为了转移责任而遵循建议、锚定效应以及遵循建议的社会规范。

articles.title_en: Unemployment and the direction of technical change
articles.title_cn: 失业与技术变革的方向
articles.abstract_en: I construct and analyze a growth model in which technical change can increase unemployment. I first analyze the forces that deliver a constant steady state unemployment rate in this setting. Labor-saving technical change increases unemployment, which lowers wages and creates incentives for future investment in labor-using technologies. In the long run, this interaction generates a balanced growth path that is observationally equivalent to that of the standard neoclassical growth model, except that it also incorporates a positive steady state level of unemployment and a falling relative price of investment. I also study the effects of a permanent increase in the ability of R&D to improve labor-saving technologies. In the long run, this change leads to faster growth in output per worker and wages, but it also yields higher unemployment and a lower labor share of income. In the short run, this change exacerbates existing inefficiencies and slows economic growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 我构建并分析了一个技术变革可能增加失业的增长模型。我首先分析了在该设定中产生恒定稳态失业率的力量。节省劳动的技术变革增加了失业，这降低了工资，并为未来投资于使用劳动的技术创造了激励。长期来看，这种相互作用产生了一条平衡增长路径，该路径在观测上等同于标准新古典增长模型，但还包含了正的稳态失业水平和投资相对价格的下降。我还研究了研发能力永久性提高以改进节省劳动技术的影响。长期来看，这一变化导致人均产出和工资增长加快，但也导致更高的失业率和更低的劳动收入份额。短期内，这一变化加剧了现有的低效率并减缓了经济增长。

articles.title_en: Do governments crowd out governments? Evidence from a natural experiment
articles.title_cn: 政府会挤出政府吗？来自自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Many governments operate budgets that expire at the end of the fiscal year and rush to spend large amounts at this time. The scale and breadth of this heightened spending raises the possibility of government departments crowding out each other at the year-end while competing with one another for limited suppliers. This may exacerbate the extent of year-end spending spikes. We investigate this possibility using expenditures of all overseas embassies and offices of the UK. We leverage a unique setting where embassies share the UK fiscal year for their budgeting but operate in countries with varying fiscal years. Our results show that: (1) in every country embassies spend more at the UK fiscal year-end than in the average month; (2) the extent of this extra spending is greater in countries that have a fiscal year that overlaps with the UK; (3) embassies spend more at the end of the fiscal years of local firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多政府的预算在财政年度结束时到期，并在此期间急于支出大量资金。这种支出规模的扩大和范围的广泛，提出了政府部门在年底相互竞争有限供应商时可能相互挤出的可能性。这可能加剧年底支出高峰的程度。我们利用英国所有海外大使馆和办事处的支出来调查这种可能性。我们利用了一个独特的设置，即大使馆在预算编制时共享英国的财政年度，但所在国家的财政年度各不相同。我们的结果表明：（1）在每个国家，大使馆在英国财政年度末的支出都高于平均月份；（2）这种额外支出的程度在与英国财政年度重叠的国家更大；（3）大使馆在当地公司财政年度末的支出更多。

articles.title_en: The spread of misinformation in networks with individual and social learning
articles.title_cn: 个体学习与社会学习网络中的错误信息传播
articles.abstract_en: The paper studies the spread of misinformation when agents have both individual and social learning. In the presence of sources of misinformation, the most vulnerable and harmful agents are those with poor individual learning and high centrality in the network. However, if opinions are polarized, providing some agents with better private information can backfire on other agents. Moreover, the incentives to spread misinformation have an inverted U-shaped relationship with the spreader’s influence; and, under certain conditions, an unaware spreader can be more harmful than a purposeful one. Overall, this paper warns that any policy that fails to consider both the precision of agents’ private information and the network structure runs the risk of backfiring.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当个体同时具有个体学习和社会学习时错误信息的传播。在存在错误信息来源的情况下，最脆弱和受害最深的个体是那些个体学习能力差且在网络中具有高中心性的个体。然而，如果观点极化，向某些个体提供更好的私人信息可能会对其他个体产生反效果。此外，传播错误信息的激励与传播者的影响力呈倒U型关系；并且在某些条件下，不知情的传播者可能比有目的的传播者更有害。总体而言，本文警告说，任何未能同时考虑个体私人信息的精确性和网络结构的政策都有适得其反的风险。

articles.title_en: The fiscal arithmetic of a slowdown in trend growth
articles.title_cn: 趋势增长放缓的财政算术
articles.abstract_en: We study the fiscal policy implications of a slowdown in trend growth using an estimated stochastic growth model. Our analysis underscores the risks associated with fiscal rules linked to growth rates, which may prove unsustainable under permanent shifts in productivity growth. For equilibria to exist, fiscal policy must respond to the slowdown ensuring that the government budget constraint holds in the low growth regime. While the slowdown imposes significant welfare costs on households, it also triggers a substantial endogenous response that boosts capital accumulation and functions as an automatic stabilizer. If fiscal policy maintains the provision of public goods per capita constant, the slowdown gives rise to a pleasant fiscal arithmetic, requiring tax cuts or a higher target debt-to-output ratio for long-term fiscal sustainability. We discuss the ramifications of various fiscal strategies, including increasing per capita public spending, altering the tax structure, and adjusting the target debt-to-output ratio.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个估计的随机增长模型研究趋势增长放缓的财政政策含义。我们的分析强调了与增长率挂钩的财政规则所伴随的风险，这些规则在生产率增长永久性转变下可能不可持续。为了均衡存在，财政政策必须对放缓做出反应，确保政府预算约束在低增长体制下成立。虽然放缓给家庭带来了显著的福利成本，但它也引发了实质性的内生反应，促进资本积累并充当自动稳定器。如果财政政策保持人均公共产品供给不变，放缓将产生令人愉快的财政算术，要求减税或提高目标债务产出比以实现长期财政可持续性。我们讨论了各种财政策略的影响，包括增加人均公共支出、改变税收结构以及调整目标债务产出比。

articles.title_en: The role of immigration in a deep recession
articles.title_cn: 移民在深度衰退中的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of pre-Great Recession immigrant inflows on the labour market during a recession. It develops a random search model of the labour market featuring vacancy persistence, endogenous return migration, and wage rigidity. Consistent with the Spanish data, some immigrants in the model leave the country during the recession, freeing up jobs for natives. Yet, differences in match-quality draws between immigrants and natives also impact firms’ job creation decisions. The return-migration channel positively affects natives, while job creation effects are negative in the calibrated Spanish economy. I find that immigrants mitigate the impact of the recession and enhance natives’ welfare. During the recession, the native unemployment rate would have been 2 percentage points higher in the absence of the pre-crisis immigration boom. Return migration plays a key role, with short- and medium-run impacts on the native unemployment rate 6 times larger than all other channels combined.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了大衰退前移民流入对衰退期间劳动力市场的影响。本文构建了一个包含职位持续性、内生性回迁和工资刚性的劳动力市场随机搜索模型。与西班牙数据一致，模型中的一些移民在衰退期间离开该国，为本地人腾出工作岗位。然而，移民与本地人在匹配质量上的差异也会影响企业的职位创造决策。在 calibrated 的西班牙经济中，回迁渠道对本地人产生积极影响，而职位创造效应则为负。我发现移民减轻了衰退的影响并提高了本地人的福利。在衰退期间，如果没有危机前的移民潮，本地失业率将高出 2 个百分点。回迁移民发挥了关键作用，其对本地失业率的短期和中期影响是其他所有渠道总和 6 倍。

articles.title_en: Expressways and policy choices of local governments
articles.title_cn: 高速公路与地方政府政策选择
articles.abstract_en: We examine how intercity road connection affects the policy choices of local governments, using the construction of China’s national expressway as a natural experiment. We show that peripheral counties reduced the level of spending and changed the spending composition since the expressway connection. They became less involved in spending competition, increased the effective tax rate on private firms, and slowed down the privatization of state-owned firms. These results are consistent with the view that mobile capital tends to relocate from peripheral areas to core regions with a lower trade cost. We further show that such changes in government policies contribute significantly to the output decline in these regions after the expressway connection.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用中国国家高速公路建设作为自然实验，考察城际公路连接如何影响地方政府的政策选择。我们表明，自高速公路连接以来，外围县降低了支出水平并改变了支出构成。它们参与支出竞争的程度降低，提高了对私营企业的有效税率，并减缓了国有企业的私有化进程。这些结果与以下观点一致：流动资本倾向于从外围地区迁移到贸易成本较低的核心区域。我们进一步表明，这些政府政策的变化对高速公路连接后这些地区的产出下降有显著贡献。

articles.title_en: Does one (unconventional) size fit all? Effects of the ECB’s unconventional monetary policies on the euro area economies
articles.title_cn: 一种（非常规）规模是否适用于所有情况？欧洲央行非常规货币政策对欧元区经济的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses the macroeconomic impact of ECB’s unconventional monetary policies (UMPs) in the euro area. We show that: (i) the relevance of the transmission channels has changed over time, with portfolio re-balancing becoming more important than the signalling effect after June 2014; (ii) there exists a substantial heterogeneity in the transmission to core and peripheral economies. By leveraging on these findings, we identify UMP shocks in a time-varying SVAR with “dynamic” restrictions and we quantify the macroeconomic impact of ECB’s measures via counterfactual analyses. We find that, absent those measures between 2014 and 2018, output growth would be on average 0.27 pp lower in peripheral countries, whereas inflation would drop on average by 0.2 pp in core economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了欧洲央行非常规货币政策（UMPs）对欧元区的宏观经济影响。我们表明：（i）传导渠道的相关性随时间发生了变化，投资组合再平衡在2014年六月后变得比信号效应更为重要；（ii）核心经济体和外围经济体的传导存在显著异质性。基于这些发现，我们在具有“动态”限制的时变SVAR中识别UMP冲击，并通过反事实分析量化欧洲央行措施的宏观经济影响。我们发现，在2014年至2018年间，若没有这些措施，外围国家的产出增长平均将低0.27个百分点，而核心经济体的通胀平均将下降0.2个百分点。

articles.title_en: Social norms, political polarization, and vaccination attitudes: Evidence from a survey experiment in Turkey
articles.title_cn: 社会规范、政治极化与疫苗接种态度：来自土耳其调查实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines vaccination as a descriptive social norm in the context of the Covid-19 pandemic. Using a large-scale survey experiment in Turkey, we first elicit respondents’ vaccination attitudes and show that political affiliation is a strong predictor of it. We then use economic games to measure the extent of outgroup discrimination induced by respondents’ attitudes towards vaccination. We find that while both pro- and anti-vaxxers discriminate against each other substantially, the pro-vaxxers discriminate more than the anti-vaxxers do. This polarization intensifies when pro- and anti-vaxxers perceive a political difference between them. Using randomized informational treatments, we show that a reminder or priming of external threats, appealing to a broadly shared social identity, might mitigate such outgroup discrimination.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在Covid-19大流行的背景下，将疫苗接种视为一种描述性社会规范进行研究。通过在土耳其进行的大规模调查实验，我们首先获取受访者的疫苗接种态度，并表明政治归属是其强有力的预测因素。随后，我们使用经济博弈来衡量受访者因疫苗接种态度而产生的对外群体歧视程度。我们发现，虽然支持疫苗者和反对疫苗者都相互歧视，但支持疫苗者的歧视程度高于反对疫苗者。当支持疫苗者和反对疫苗者感知到彼此存在政治差异时，这种极化会加剧。通过随机化信息干预，我们表明，提醒或启动外部威胁，并诉诸于广泛共享的社会认同，可能有助于缓解这种对外群体的歧视。
